output.answer_markdown: Verizon's FY2022 10-K describes its strategy as requiring significant capital investment, and it calls 2022 a peak year of capital investment [1][2][3]. The filing reports $23.1 billion of capital expenditures for 2022 [1]. I could not confirm capital intensity against revenue because no computed capex figure is in the numeric results, so the question is only partly answered.

claims.text: Verizon's 2022 investments included $23.1 billion for capital expenditures.
